tweets.text: Good model :) Artificial Analysis (@ArtificialAnlys) SpaceXAI just released Grok 4.5, and it ranks #4 on GDPval-AA v2 with an Elo of 1543 - behind only the latest Claude releases from Anthropic on real-world agentic knowledge work tasks Grok 4.5 achieved this score at a cost of $0.49 per GDPval task to sit clearly on the Pareto frontier for performance versus cost. This cost is lower than GLM-5.2 and Kimi K2.6, and nearly 90% cheaper than the models ahead of it on our leaderboard. We’re finalizing the remaining Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index evaluations and will share final results soo

tweets.text: This is the first model that I personally prefer over Opus when I am iterating with a single agent. Fast Grok 4.5 feels very very good!
